description: Wi-Fi Enabled Device Counts Other is a dataset listed in Geelong Data Exchange open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Geelong Data Exchange. Central Geelong Wi-Fi Enabled Device Counts. Coverage: Geelong region, Victoria. The portal files it under Urban Planning, Transport. Its keywords are Device Counting, IoT, device counting, sensor, people, crowds. The portal shows 10,489 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-02-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-geelongdataexchange-com-au-portal.
